test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘__**bold**__’ in the given sentence.

A person can be friendly, timid, clever, or fearless based on the context of the situation.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. 'timid'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bold"** means showing a willingness to take risks; confident and courageous. (साहसी)

 
 
• **Example:** The bold explorer ventured into the unknown territories without hesitation.
 
 
 
• **"Timid"** refers to someone who is easily frightened and lacks self-confidence. (डरपोक)
 
 
• **Example:** The timid child hid behind his mother when strangers approached.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'bold'** is **'timid'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. 'timid'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Friendly **(मित्रवत): Showing kindness and pleasantness.

 
 
• **Example:** She was friendly to everyone she met, always offering a warm smile.
 
 
 
• **Clever **(चतुर): Quick to understand, learn, and devise or apply ideas; intelligent.
 
 
• **Example:** The clever student solved the complex problem in just a few minutes.
 
 
 
• **Fearless** (निर्भय): Lacking fear; brave.
 
 
• **Example:** The fearless firefighter rushed into the burning building to save the trapped residents.
